chunks.text: An improvement in the finances of working people at the lower end of the economic scale might help explain why their spending on both essentials and discretionary items has accelerated recently, some economists said.
New federal data this week showed an acceleration in weekly earnings growth for low- and middle-income full-time workers during the second quarter, compared with a year earlier.
